docs/handoff.md:11:The saved first-pointer-move drag fix landed in PR115, merged as `c14c395a6efb1da4e97397ca168984b67fb65683` after exact-head Actions success. Its source stash `12796c6d7fb9c5080f23213ad3c8abd230fd51e0` remains preserved. The first delivered move starts the gesture, including zero delta; ordinary clicks without a move still toggle selection. Do not infer complete Flash Point/display-setter precision from the measured final quarter-pixel export or the browser adapter's intermediate eighth-pixel assertion.
docs/handoff.md:23:PR123 merged as `d10c91e55cf0cc73426e54e662f9522f908c384e` after exact-head Actions success; fetched master has the tested tree. The crossing follow-up now separates logical coordinates, fresh wrappers, raw actor/pose cache records, actual parent/callback links and retained orphan artwork. Read [crossing source contracts](crossing-source-reference.md) before changing those paths. Source Run does not cancel its selected branch when a dialog opens; the shared return state can restore transit without a destination, while secondary-help Close writes ordinary mode with an attachment pending. TankData.WipeTank empties the actual actor before queued detachment, correcting the earlier inference of retained dead-patient body paint. The known callback/read boundaries are scoped, and browser mid-crossing pause retains its existing adapter. The full ordinary-input boss/win and original/Adobe comparison remain unfinished.
docs/handoff.md:29:Then continue the fidelity ledger's full remaining work: controlled creator snapping/selection/timing, complete advanced-part/contact/damage/crossing behavior, nested frame/constructor RNG and event order, native vectors/fonts/filters and HUD/menu transitions, audio/medal edge cases, and an ordinary-input boss/win playthrough compared against the original. Native MP3 playback now honors the original positive seek/count window before ready assets are exposed; do not revert to playing raw MP3 blobs. Music uses the shared stage clock and source accepted-request/mute memory rules. Hit audio belongs to virtual collision callbacks and the World.Run tail timer, including its zero-reset frame and interruption behavior, rather than generic damage or a browser throttle. PR119 merged as `f47e093d51bcf50a53d74901ced137ca5cf09704` after exact-head Actions success; fetched master has its tested tree. The scene-request/completion follow-up separates fresh menus/games from retained child views and settings updates. Read the final fidelity entry before changing completion-volume writes or accepted-request/mute memory. A bounded bytecode/placement audit found no base-game charging caller; shock clips and charging sounds occur in loading/audio banks. Do not add dispatch solely from those definitions. Dynamic reachability, exact loop-edge/event timing and synchronized audio/Adobe comparisons remain open. Complete pause pixel/constructor timing comparison and original game-bitmap readback remain open. PR118 merged as `e623e7d1cc48745c0ac024eacc70f1ff4ab714f7` after exact-head Actions success; fetched master has the tested tree. NPC damage/boundary deactivation now shares primary final callbacks before data clearing, the dead flag and field callback. Enemy drops/pop/infection precede those finals; allies do not spread infection on damage death, while allied boundary exits drop/pop before deactivation. Keep the current ally start/end removal timing and the existing Healer beam lifetime. These source-derived fixtures do not prove ordinary infection reachability or full constructor/event parity. Accelerated pilots use a public upgrade-selection adapter and cannot establish an ordinary-input playthrough.
docs/handoff.md:33:A separate supplied-art session also earned its first Insidious upgrade through actual offered controls, then later lost it and reached Basic Tank1/50 through ordinary damage/escape. It remains partial evidence. Its early observer incorrectly looked for green mock pickups; supplied symbols1816/1817/1820 are blue, so those early pickup classifications do not prove collections. A fresh original session developed repeated AVM2 `TypeError #1009` in `BTAGameWorld.MoveAvatarToNewBubblefieldLocation`; JavaScript `pageerror` alone missed it. The failed original runtime is suspended for diagnosis. Do not treat it as a healthy in-game pause or a completed comparison. The preceding recreation suppressed nested escape; the crossing follow-up now models its source ownership and shared state. The static sufficient error path does not establish the retained failure's cause; causality for this observed failure and Adobe behavior are unproved.
docs/handoff.md:40:PR124 merged as `a13da73ca74198c4e297f7acdac12c4b681d64fb` after current-head Actions success; fetched master has the tested tree `f504ccc05bcf3acf34eeadb434f2f17a0e5dbb04`. The next source audit corrects offline upgrade fallback: read [the exact library lookup](upgrade-source-reference.md). Cache tier uses a zero-based part-tier row and class GP thresholds; it is separate from retained playable unlocks. Keep the live saved-avatar library independent of optional saved-enemy sources, and preserve existing displayed offers when that library changes. Upgrade artwork/fade/preview fitting and full ordinary gameplay comparison remain unfinished. The last recorded paused supplied-art session on CDP9226 has Basic Tank14/50 on the PR124 build; later production builds do not turn that resident client into newer-code evidence. Its observer repeatedly reversed during transitions, so stalled progress was not proof of a game bug.
docs/handoff.md:43:The current five-layer batch starts with PR125 (`fix/source-upgrade-defaults`) and PR126 (`stack/125-02-deployment-controls`). Master remains at `a13da73ca74198c4e297f7acdac12c4b681d64fb`. docs/handoff.md:49:The fifth layer implements [fresh capture and source frame ownership](upgrade-frame-reference.md). Keep one cohort across Main effects/beforeStep/mainStep/background/child step: World.Run is a mainStep callback, later menus are step callbacks. Check the retained menu owner at frame entry; a newborn menu does not interrupt that selected World.Run or start Run until the next cohort. World.advanceArtwork is the former finally pass, independent of skipped interface/combat/hit-timer work. Explicit background commands preserve resume into secondary help and live efficiency overrides. Local873-test and22-case mock/supplied browser validation passes; full captured-layer/constructor/Adobe and ordinary-game limits remain explicit.
